title: Check usernames, display names and tags at sign-up

defects.what: Display names are lower-cased instead of case-folded, so Straße and STRASSE are not seen as duplicates.
The username pattern uses match with ^...$, and $ matches before a trailing newline, so alice\n is accepted.
Display names are not Unicode-normalized, so a name typed with a combining accent passes as a different person's name.
Only trailing digits are removed before the reserved-word check, so admin_2 is allowed.

defects.what: lstrip removes every leading #, so ##news is accepted as news instead of rejected.
The CSV reader does not skip the space after a comma, so a quoted tag after a space is split apart and the valid field is rejected.
The tag character check uses isalnum alone, which is true for accented and non-Latin letters and digits, so café is accepted.
